2116887452904194383.en_summary: This is now the 9th time in the past 40 years that the S&P 500 saw at least 6 negative calendar months thru the end of October. 7 of the previous 8 times this happened, SPX finished negative for the entire year (Jan-Dec). 2005 was the only positive year overall.
2116887452904194383.zh_summary: 這是過去 40 年來第 9 次標普 500 至 10 月底至少有 6 個負值日曆月份。前 8 次中有 7 次全年（1-12 月）SPX 為負。2005 年是唯一全年正值的年份。
